sn36.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn36.8:1.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn36.8:2.1: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya
sn36.8:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn36.8:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn36.8:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti.
sn36.8:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti …pe… bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
sn36.8:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno hoti.
sn36.8:4.4: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya
sn36.8:5.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati sukhā vedanā
sn36.8:5.4: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.8:5.7: ayaṃ kho pana phasso anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno
sn36.8:5.8: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā kho myāyaṃ sukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti.
sn36.8:5.9: so phasse ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati vayānupassī virāgānupassī nirodhānupassī paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.8:5.10: tassa phasse ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato vayā virāgā nirodhā paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo phasse ca sukhāya ca vedanāya rāgānusayo so pahiyyati.
sn36.8:6.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa …pe…
sn36.8:6.6: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.8:6.8: imameva phassaṃ paṭicca ayaṃ kho pana phasso anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno …pe…
sn36.8:6.10: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn36.8:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya
sn36.8:7.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn36.8:7.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti.
sn36.8:7.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānātīti.
